_evidence: 0x0051cac6 reads 16 words from 0x811aa8 ('lodsw'; 'cmp ax,-1; je' skips the slot) and for each used slot k copies entry ax of the word tables 0x9e1b20/0x9e2920 and the dword table 0xa6c600 to entry 0x42d+k ('push word [eax*2+0x9e1b20] ... pop word [ebx*2+0x9e1b20]', ebx = 0x42d..0x43c) and sets bit k of the mask stored to 0x811a8c. fuzz:i32 varied only the first dword of each. The slot words are 0xffff (empty) in about a quarter of the cases, else a source entry in 0..0x3ff (the texture slots below the copy area at 0x42d; values spread over the range), and the source entries 0..0x3ff of the three tables are random (copied verbatim), so a wrong index, width or skipped slot changes memory. Every index stays inside its table.
